name: worktree-radar
description: A live radar of your parallel branches and worktrees above the prompt: which merge cleanly, which conflict, which are stacked, which a Claude session is still working on, and the order to land them. Read-only: it never merges, rebases or moves a ref.

notifyReady.title: Notify when a branch is ready
notifyReady.description: Raise a desktop notification when a branch becomes ready to land.

pollSeconds.title: Seconds between checks
pollSeconds.description: How often the open radar checks the repository for a change (1 to 60).
